title: Direct construction of scalar quantum fields by L{é}vy fields -- nontrivial exact Wightman fields in a wider field with a relaxed Gårding-Wightman Axioms-
summary: This paper introduces partial results, in the current situation, of ongoing considerations corresponding to the above title. A construction on exact relativistic quantum field model with the space time dimension $d \in {\mathbb N}$, including the case where $d \geq 4$, is going to be discussed.
